C0819.title: Shanghai Company Deleted Database After Data Leak to Evade Penalties
C0819.summary: In 2023, a Shanghai technology company database had unauthorized access risk, and some data was suspected of leaking overseas. After the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration required rectification, the company still failed to effectively fulfill data security protection responsibilities and deleted the database involved without authorization. Authorities imposed dual penalties on the company and responsible personnel under the Data Security Law, showing that improper handling after a data leak can also trigger regulatory liability.
